instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. Inside a judo dojo, the young man in the white judo gi (R4) and the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) kneel side-by-side on a blue mat against a beige wall. The young man (R4) sits on the left with hands on his thighs, looking slightly aside. The woman (R1) sits on the right, adjusting her gi lapel while looking forward. Soft, diffused indoor lighting creates a calm atmosphere.
